evidence.decision: Starts with a glance question and system-family/surface choice, separating source-update rate from system refresh opportunity and live bounded events.
evidence.artifact: Requires variant contract with freshness, sign-in/configuration, precise targets, rendering modes and realistic sample data; adaptation changes the actual variant.
evidence.transformation: Reading app replaces stretched cover grid and three inline targets with a focused Home widget and a single-target inline Continue label, retaining useful stale progress.
evidence.verification: Checks long/localized content, taps, in-place actions, desaturation hierarchy, stale-as-live and unsupported surfaces; clearly excludes unrun native timeline/rendering claims.
evidence.applicability: Handles unsupported tvOS, one inline target, Mac accented table/prose conflict, shared HomeView privacy and visionOS mounting/distance/frame constraints explicitly.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Live Activities only for bounded frequent events, complications for watch faces and controls for system controls; transfers the glance purpose.
evidence.distinctiveness: Family, rendering, freshness and spatial mounting branches make this operationally specific to widgets, beyond common evidence/deliverable structure.
